The file contains standard metadata declarations (pkgname, pkgver, etc.), source URLs, checksums, and dependencies. All `source` and `sha256sums` entries are properly defined and point to the official Haskell.org domain. There are no top-level command substitutions, unquoted variable expansions, or external network calls outside of the declared `source` array — and crucially, no execution of downloaded or dynamically fetched content at parse time.

The `_install_completion_script` function and its use in `package()` are irrelevant for this gate, as functions are not executed during `--printsrcinfo`. No malicious code is present in the global scope. The use of process substitution `<(...)` inside a function does not execute during sourcing.

Thus, simply sourcing this PKGBUILD for metadata extraction poses no security risk.
</details>
